scenes.summary: 石桥上的女孩，四种摄像机运动模式

shots.prompt: An ancient stone bridge in warm afternoon light. A young woman in a red dress stands at the center. The camera performs four smooth motions in sequence: first a constant-speed push-in from distance to close-up, then an accelerating pull-out from close to wide, then a horizontal pan from left to right keeping the subject centered, and finally a 180-degree clockwise orbit around the woman. Throughout all motions, camera movement is silky smooth with no jitter, no sudden speed changes, and no hesitation. Cinematic 24fps, photorealistic.
shots.negative_prompt: jerky camera, motion blur artifacts, sudden acceleration or deceleration, jitter, shaking, camera bounce, hesitation, speed variation, wrong motion type
